mission.title: The Vial
mission.description: Retrieve an empty cheat code vial for the Merovingian.

npc.say: Flood will give you the information you require. See that you follow his instructions precisely.
Oh, sure, that's cool. I'll check back with you later. I can get a rain check on this, right? {player}?

phase.briefing:
Now that that foolishness with Niobe is over, and Zion is temporarily pacified, we can finally get back to our own business.
The Merovingian is very interested in the powers conferred by the cheat codes Anome stole. In fact, he's got something in mind that he wants to confide to you in person. Go see him, and try not to stand there stammering like last time.

enter.say: That's the place. Time to strut your stuff!

talk.say: I have a task for you. It is of great importance to me. These..."cheat codes" come in vials, yes? We have learned that Anome's underlings stupidly throw the vials aside after consuming the fluid within. But of course, traces remain inside the vial. Our spies think they have found a location where one of the vials was consumed. Your job is to go in, and snatch the empty flask.

phase.briefing: The item should be at the indicated location. Anome's men may be about...but that's your concern now, isn't it? Just get the-- Hmm... We'll call it "poison," in case someone is listening.

done.say:
Great! Now get out of th-- Watch out!
You've got company!

near.say: Wait, I'm getting a very faint tickle of something... A slightly corrupt reading... You may be getting close.

phase.briefing:
Took your time retrieving that, didn't you?
You'll be taking the item to a certain lab of ours for containment. What? Oh, didn't I mention that we believe the cheat codes are a mutagenic agent, capable of corrupting code structures nearby? You've seen what's happened to Anome's men, yes? Why do you think the Machines had the codes in that protective case?
Oh, I wouldn't worry. The trace amounts in that vial probably won't have any significant lasting effect on you...

enter.say: That facility has a containment computer. You'll put the vial into the computer's operating chute, and it'll seal it up into a package.
The containment machine should be in there.

objective.text: Put the vial into the containment computer

done.say: Okay, now get the package back from it.

objective.text: Get the package from the containment computer

done.say:
Code corruption! They've found you!
Wait... What's the Effectuator doing in there? No time for him, just get out of there!

Hey, muchacho! I just had this great idea about network tracking, and I said to myself, I said, "You know, {player}'s the one to bounce that idea off of," so I just thought I'd pop in and...
What? Is this a bad time or something?
Stop talking to that idiot, and get that vial out of there!

phase.briefing: Now that it's safely contained, and can't harm anyone important, you'll be delivering the item to Malphas.

enter.say: Ol' Cloak-and-Dagger should be in there.

talk.say: Ah? Give it to me, please.

done.say: Thank you. The Merovingian will be delighted to know that you have fulfilled your commission.

near.say: You have something for me, operative?

mission.finish:
Feeling all right, operative? Oh, good, good. Just thought I'd check. We have to make a study of the mutagenic effects of the cheat codes; we might as well start with you.
At any rate, even if you persist in manifesting no mutations of interest, I'm sure a close study of the vial in the lab will yield useful results.
